answer: Escrowed work auction: each identity must pre-fund a small escrow to bid, and every losing bid forfeits a fixed fraction to the buyer. A clone swarm bidding across many identities pays that forfeit on each fake identity, so marginal clones lose money even when they win nothing. The escrow also ties to a single payout address, so a sparrow identity cannot recycle winnings across an island of clones without exposing a shared ledger path. That trace creates an echo of the funding source, letting the buyer reject and seize escrow from linked identities.
